definitions.gloss: process, procedure, manufacturing step, stage of work
definitions.explanation: A step or stage in a sequence of operations, especially in manufacturing, construction, or project management. Can refer to an individual step or the overall workflow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{製造|せいぞう}→製造：03289_seizou⟧{工程|こうてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{工程|こうてい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}かれている→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: This work is divided into three steps.

examples.japanese: ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、すべて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{工程|こうてい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: To maintain quality, rigorous inspections are conducted at every stage of the process.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
{工|こう} (work, construction) + {程|てい} (degree, extent, process).

USAGE:
{工程|こうてい} is used primarily in manufacturing, construction, and project management contexts. It can refer to a single step within a larger process or to the entire sequence of operations. In project management, {工程|こうてい}{表|ひょう} (process chart / schedule) is a key planning tool.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {工程|こうてい}{表|ひょう}: process chart, schedule
- {工程|こうてい}⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧: process control
- ⟦{製造|せいぞう}→製造：03289_seizou⟧{工程|こうてい}: manufacturing process
- {工程|こうてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧: to follow a process
- ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧{工程|こうてい}: the entire process
